signs.Aries: The opportunity to meet with some new people is yours today. If you are looking for that perfect love, then be different. If you stay in the same old routine, you will fall into the same old type of relationship. If you feel the need for a change, then change yourself from within first of all. Dress differently, go to whatever new places are open, and see what transpires.
signs.Taurus: Today brings with it a chance to really let your hair down and dare to do something different. The astro energy brings with it the opportunity to make some adventurous decisions concerning your love life. If you have become stuck in a rut, and your relationship has become routine rather than a passionate adventure, then it is up to you to reinvent the sparkle. Do something outrageous together!
signs.Gemini: You will have the opportunity to get off of your couch, to switch off the television, and to be present with your loved one. If it’s possible to get together, don't invite your sweetie over for yet another meal. This time dare to do something different, bringing a smile to your faces. Go way out beyond your normal boundaries and try those things you have never before attempted. Go boldly forth and fall in love again!
signs.Cancer: You could try reading aloud some modern poetry to woo the love of your life into your life. Better still, you could try writing some. You'll find yourself approaching the whole subject of romance in a new and unconventional life. Dress differently, try a new scent do your hair in a new style or wear a flattering new accessory. Basically, break from your usual routine and see what transpires.
signs.Leo: You will find yourself emerging from behind your lonely shell and do something positive about the state of your love life. If you have been hiding away, unable to fully face the mess that is your current relationship, then take time to do so. Be bold, speak from your heart, and don't take any more. Give ultimatums and give it your best shot.
signs.Virgo: Partners will encourage you to be more truly yourself today.  You will be overcome with the urge to experiment, and also to be honest and open. Just for once, don't hide behind your royal mannerisms, but dare to shed your mask and be utterly yourself. You may find it refreshingly different and exhilarating. You may even get to like it. Your partner will certainly enjoy the new you!
signs.Libra: If you feel the need for a change, then do things differently. You will be moving in new circles, especially if you are single and looking for that special love. Take a break from your normal routine, and for once do things in a new way. Love will find you if you take time to meet new people and get involved in new interests.
signs.Scorpio: This is a good day for experimentation and trying a new way of handling your partner. Instead of seeing them in the same old way and thinking you already know everything about them, try, for once, seeing them in a new light. Give them a chance to be themselves, to be different, to be new. Allow them some freedom to make mistakes, but also to triumph. This is the way of love!
signs.Sagittarius: If you are looking for that special person, the one who is going to take your breath away, then you will need to do things a little differently. Why not consider wearing another color apart from black, and to take off those steely dark glasses. Make it your goal to communicate with at least half a dozen new people and stop hiding away.
signs.Capricorn: Now is the time to decide where you are going to take your lover on holiday. Don't opt for that standard package tour. If you want to renew your partnership, then it may need a little cosmetic surgery. Look for a deal that offers you the chance to do a little adventuring together in an unconventional setting. You may even fall in love again!
signs.Aquarius: Go bananas, especially if you are looking for that special person to love. You will need to consider a new approach. If you’re able to attend a small party or celebration, then wear clothes that bring out that hidden and daring side of your nature, that femme fatale in hiding. But you also have to be prepared to act the part and get right into your new role.
signs.Pisces: You need no encouraging to be different, as you just can't help it. Today you will have another chance to express the unique qualities that make you so special. If you are looking for romance, then don't try too hard. Just be engrossed in being utterly yourself, enjoy the feeling of being yourself - and love will soon find you! You will attract someone who is your perfect complement.
